mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, name, options, seq, template_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM spec WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE spec SET deleted_at = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), update_user_id = #{et.updateUserId}, update_time = #{et.updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{et.id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version = #{MP_OPTLOCK_VERSION_ORIGINAL}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.tenant_id, s.create_user_id, s.create_time, s.update_user_id, s.update_time, s.deleted_at, s.version, s.name, s.options, s.seq, s.template_id FROM category c JOIN template t ON t.id = c.template_id AND t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN spec s ON s.template_id = t.id AND s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.name = #{categoryName} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id ORDER BY s.seq, s.id
